conversation.note: Keep the controller in a ViewModel. Conversation only renders the list; add PromptInput yourself or use Chat. Forward both approvals and forms.

messages.note: Use for one message or a non-lazy layout. For long histories use Conversation, which virtualizes reply blocks.

prompt-input.note: The caller owns text and attachments. Clear text only after send accepts it. Set allowQueue when the controller can queue prompts.

suggestions.note: Selecting a suggestion only invokes onSelect; the caller decides whether to fill the composer or send immediately.

empty-state.note: Show while history is empty. Set showHero=false in a short container.

branch.note: index is zero-based. The app must update the selected message; this control does not edit history.

checkpoint.note: The element confirms before calling onRestore. Restoring the controller changes conversation history, not files changed by past tools.

queue.note: The controller owns queue order. Stop or error pauses automatic sending; wire Send now to resume explicitly.

open-in-chat.note: Opens the chosen external chat with the prompt in its URL. Let the user choose; do not pass hidden context or credentials.

model-selector.note: The selection is UI state only. Your backend factory must read it on the next turn; preserve the current controller/history.

context.note: Pass measured token usage and the chosen model limit. This indicator does not tokenize messages or truncate history.

loading.note: These are Material 3 components, exposed by the Material dependency. Use while waiting for initial output; opt in to ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi.

shimmer.note: Set active=false when work ends. Prefer a plain status label for long messages.

markdown.note: Pass the accumulated text, not just the latest token. streaming defers expensive rendering of incomplete content.

code-block.note: language controls syntax highlighting. The element provides copy; it does not execute code.

math.note: Pass TeX without Markdown fences. For mixed prose use MarkdownContent with dollar delimiters. KaTeX assets are bundled offline.

mermaid-flowchart.note: Pass complete Mermaid source. The default WebView renderer works offline; the native renderer requires its optional artifact and experimental opt-in.

mermaid-sequence.note: Pass complete Mermaid source. The default WebView renderer works offline; the native renderer requires its optional artifact and experimental opt-in.

mermaid-class.note: Pass complete Mermaid source. The default WebView renderer works offline; the native renderer requires its optional artifact and experimental opt-in.

mermaid-pie.note: Pass complete Mermaid source. The default WebView renderer works offline; the native renderer requires its optional artifact and experimental opt-in.

mermaid-streaming.note: Keep complete=false until the diagram closes; partial source is shown instead of repeatedly parsing an unfinished diagram.

reasoning.note: Use a stable part id. Set isStreaming while reasoning arrives; durationMs is elapsed time in milliseconds.

sources.note: Source ids must remain stable. URLs open through LocalUriHandler; override it to route links in your app.

inline-citation.note: Use the same source list for the answer and its citations. Citation markers are linked to source entries; this does not verify generated claims.

tool-calls.note: Update the same part as input/progress/output arrives. onDecision carries reason, editedInput and remember; a card without callbacks is read-only.

sub-agents.note: Set kind=ToolKind.Delegation and subagent upstream. ToolPartView selects delegation rendering and applies custom renderers; nested approvals share the callback.

agent-computer.note: Keep computer state with the screen. Auto chooses a side pane or bottom sheet from container width; use Hosted with your own adaptive layout.

agent-computer-reply.note: Chat includes the panel and preview cards. Tool category/location and file parts must be set upstream; ordinary function names alone are not UI semantics.

step-views.note: Pass screenshots as the AgentStep files. Tool category selects terminal, diff or browser presentation; give the view a bounded area.

agent.note: This is a descriptive card, not an agent runtime. Populate capabilities from your backend or agent card.

confirmation.note: Respect approvalAnswers: only offer reasons/edited input supported by the backend. Approval must resume the waiting tool, not create a new user turn.

question.note: Store the returned selected ids/text and forward them to your agent. answered prevents resubmitting a completed question.

input-request.note: Use the exact request id when responding. Forms validate the supported JSON Schema fields; URL requests require the user to complete the external flow.

plan.note: The caller owns step progress. Use COMPLETE/ACTIVE/PENDING; rendering a plan does not schedule or execute tasks.

task.note: items describe task progress and badges; the component does not change files.

chain-of-thought.note: Render available step summaries and sources. This component does not request or reveal reasoning from the model.

data-parts.note: Known plan/task shapes render as elements; custom names can be registered in AiElementsRenderers.data. Unknown data remains visible as structured data.

jsx-typography.note: Requires ai-elements-genui (minSdk 26). Supported JSX compiles to native A2UI components; arbitrary JavaScript is not executed.

jsx-controls.note: Requires ai-elements-genui (minSdk 26). Supported JSX compiles to native A2UI components; arbitrary JavaScript is not executed.

jsx-cards.note: Requires ai-elements-genui (minSdk 26). Supported JSX compiles to native A2UI components; arbitrary JavaScript is not executed.

jsx-form.note: onAction receives the action name and current model. Validate and route it in your app; the renderer does not perform server writes.

jsx-streaming.note: Pass accumulated JSX and keep the composable at a stable position while streaming. Incomplete tags wait; keep initial bindings stable to retain edits.

a2ui.note: Get a surface from A2uiState after processing standard A2UI events. For chat integration use a2uiRenderer and route actions through the transport binding.

artifact.note: Supply action buttons through the actions slot. The app owns save/share operations and associated permissions.

web-preview.note: Shows HTML or a URL in a sandboxed WebView. Do not treat preview content as trusted app UI; use MCP Apps for its standard server bridge.

image.note: Set mediaType and url, optionally filename. LocalFileLoader customizes byte loading and authentication; image taps open the built-in viewer.

attachments.note: The app owns the list and file picker. Removal changes the list only; it does not delete the underlying file.

video.note: Use mediaType=video/mp4 (or the actual type). The platform codec must support the file; preview and playback need a readable source.

document.note: PDF previews use PdfRenderer. Other formats need an installed viewer; files are shared through the library FileProvider.

audio.note: rememberAudioPlayerState creates and releases the player with composition. Keep the source stable. Transcript times and seek positions are milliseconds.

voice-mode.note: Declare RECORD_AUDIO and let the permission flow complete. Requires installed recognition/TTS services. onClose should dismiss the hosting dialog or screen.

persona.note: Visual state only; this does not listen or speak. Feed level from your audio state when showing LISTENING or SPEAKING.

speech-input.note: Declare RECORD_AUDIO. State owns the recognizer lifecycle; show speech.error on failure and distinguish interim/final transcripts in onTranscript.

voice-selectors.note: Selectors report choices; configure your audio engine or SpeechSettings separately. Available microphones and voices depend on the device.

terminal.note: Pass accumulated command output. ANSI styling is supported, with bounded scrollback; this is an output view, not an interactive shell.

stack-trace.note: Takes raw trace text. App frames and dependency frames can be folded; this view does not upload crash reports.

test-results.note: Supply actual test results and durations in milliseconds; the component does not run tests.

file-tree.note: The caller provides file nodes; selecting a node does not read it. Pass expanded paths when you need initial folder expansion.

commit.note: Metadata display only. Hash/message/files come from your source control tool; no git operation is performed.

schema-display.note: Displays a schema summary; it does not validate or invoke the endpoint. requestBody/responseBody are example text.

package-info.note: The app supplies the change classification and size metadata. No dependency resolution or update is performed.

environment-variables.note: Values marked secret are visually masked, not encrypted. Do not put real credentials in examples or screenshots.

sandbox.note: This is a tabbed presentation of code and results. Execution is supplied separately by harness-shell or your backend.

snippet.note: Displays a copyable command; clicking copy does not execute it.

workflow-canvas.note: Use stable node ids and edges referring to them; positions are dp. Give the canvas a bounded size. Use nodeContent/nodeToolbar/panel slots to customize.
